name: Your Name
title: Cybersecurity Educator & Public Speaker
tagline: Talks that make security, technology and careers make sense — for students, teams and communities.
bio: I speak at colleges, conferences and companies about cybersecurity, ethical hacking and building a career in tech. My sessions are hands-on, story-driven and built around the audience in the room — whether that is first-year students or a security team. Edit this bio in config.json.

topics.title: Ethical Hacking 101
topics.description: How attackers think, live demos of common attacks, and how to start learning legally and safely.

topics.title: Careers in Cybersecurity
topics.description: Roles, certifications, salaries and a realistic roadmap from college to your first security job.

topics.title: Staying Safe Online
topics.description: Phishing, scams, passwords and privacy — practical habits for everyone, no jargon.

topics.title: AI and the Future of Security
topics.description: How AI is changing both attack and defence, and what skills will matter next.

topics.title: VAPT for Teams
topics.description: A practical walkthrough of vulnerability assessment and penetration testing for engineering teams.

topics.title: Building While Studying
topics.description: Turning side projects into a portfolio, internships and maybe a company — lessons from doing it.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.a: At least 3 days ahead, ideally 2–3 weeks for in-person events so travel can be arranged.
Your request holds the slot straight away. I review every request personally and confirm (or suggest another time) usually within 48 hours.
It depends on the event. Student-run and non-profit events are often free or travel-cost-only — mention your budget in the notes.

faqs.q: Can I suggest my own topic?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Choose 'Something else' in the topic list and describe what your audience needs.
